vocabulary.definitionEn: To discuss something in order to reach an agreement.
vocabulary.example: We negotiated a longer payment period with the supplier.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Chúng tôi đã thương lượng được kỳ hạn thanh toán dài hơn với nhà cung cấp.

vocabulary.definitionEn: To give a share of something for a particular purpose.
vocabulary.example: Half the budget has been allocated to staff training.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Một nửa ngân sách đã được phân bổ cho đào tạo nhân sự.

vocabulary.definitionEn: To act in accordance with a rule or request.
vocabulary.example: All contractors must comply with the site safety rules.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Mọi nhà thầu phải tuân thủ quy định an toàn công trường.

vocabulary.definitionEn: Not yet paid or dealt with; or extremely good.
vocabulary.example: There are two outstanding invoices on the account.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Tài khoản còn hai hoá đơn chưa thanh toán.

vocabulary.definitionEn: To change something in order to correct or improve it.
vocabulary.example: The forecast has been revised downwards twice this quarter.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Dự báo đã được điều chỉnh giảm hai lần trong quý này.

vocabulary.meaningVi: hoạt động mua sắm, thu mua
vocabulary.definitionEn: The process of buying goods and services for an organisation.
vocabulary.example: Procurement requires three quotations for any order above ten thousand.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Bộ phận thu mua yêu cầu ba báo giá cho mọi đơn trên mười nghìn.

vocabulary.definitionEn: The building and land occupied by a business.
vocabulary.example: The company is moving to larger premises in March.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Công ty sẽ chuyển sang mặt bằng lớn hơn vào tháng Ba.

vocabulary.definitionEn: To pay someone back money they have spent.
vocabulary.example: Travel costs will be reimbursed within two weeks.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Chi phí đi lại sẽ được hoàn trả trong vòng hai tuần.

vocabulary.definitionEn: Likely to become or do something in the future.
vocabulary.example: Prospective tenants must provide two references.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Người thuê tiềm năng phải cung cấp hai thư giới thiệu.

vocabulary.meaningVi: tinh gọn, đơn giản hoá quy trình
vocabulary.definitionEn: To make a process simpler and more efficient.
vocabulary.example: The new system streamlines approval from five steps to two.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Hệ thống mới rút quy trình duyệt từ năm bước xuống hai.

vocabulary.definitionEn: A statement of how much a job or product will cost.
vocabulary.example: Their quotation was the lowest but excluded installation.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Báo giá của họ thấp nhất nhưng chưa gồm lắp đặt.

vocabulary.example: The error was corrected in all subsequent editions.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Lỗi này đã được sửa trong mọi ấn bản sau đó.

activities.title: Part 1 — Photographs
activities.format: TOEIC Listening — Part 1 · Photographs, 6 câu, bốn lựa chọn, chỉ nghe không có chữ
activities.instructionsVi: Nhìn ảnh rồi nghe bốn câu mô tả, chọn câu đúng nhất. Ở mục tiêu 650, bẫy chính chuyển từ 'sai hành động' sang 'sai thì bị động' — phân biệt 'is being placed' (có người đang làm) với 'has been placed' (không có ai trong ảnh).
activities.promptEn:
Look at each photograph and listen to the four statements. Select the statement that best describes what you see.

PHOTO 1: A woman in a laboratory coat looks through a microscope. Beside her, a notebook lies open with a pen resting on it. No one else is in the room.

PHOTO 2: A construction site. Steel beams have been stacked along one edge of the site. A crane stands idle; its hook hangs empty above the stack.

PHOTO 3: Two men in a kitchen. One is chopping vegetables on a board; the other is reading from a tablet propped against the wall.

PHOTO 4: An airport check-in area. A queue of travellers waits behind a barrier. At the desk, an agent is attaching a tag to a suitcase.

PHOTO 5: A lecture theatre with tiered seating. Every seat is empty. A laptop sits open on the front desk and the projector screen shows a title slide.

PHOTO 6: A garden centre. Rows of potted plants line a bench. A customer is bending down to read a label; a watering can stands on the ground nearby.

transcript.speaker: Photo 1
transcript.text: (A) She's writing in a notebook. (B) She's looking through a microscope. (C) She's putting on a coat. (D) She's talking to a colleague.

transcript.speaker: Photo 2
transcript.text: (A) Beams are being lifted by the crane. (B) Workers are carrying materials. (C) Steel beams have been stacked at the site. (D) The crane is being repaired.

transcript.speaker: Photo 3
transcript.text: (A) They're eating a meal together. (B) One of the men is chopping vegetables. (C) They're washing dishes. (D) A tablet is being handed over.

transcript.speaker: Photo 4
transcript.text: (A) Passengers are boarding a plane. (B) A tag is being attached to a suitcase. (C) The queue has been cleared. (D) Luggage is being loaded onto a cart.

transcript.speaker: Photo 5
transcript.text: (A) A lecture is being given. (B) Students are taking notes. (C) The room has been prepared for a presentation. (D) The screen is being lowered.

transcript.speaker: Photo 6
transcript.text: (A) Plants are being watered. (B) A customer is examining a label. (C) The bench is being moved. (D) Pots are being stacked.

questions.prompt: Photo 1
questions.explanationVi: Cuốn sổ có trong ảnh nhưng bà ấy KHÔNG viết, cây bút đang đặt trên đó. (D) sai vì ảnh ghi rõ không có ai khác trong phòng.

questions.prompt: Photo 2

options.text: Beams are being lifted by the crane.
Steel beams have been stacked at the site.

questions.explanationVi: Cần cẩu đứng yên, móc trống, không có người. Ảnh không người thì phải dùng hoàn thành bị động 'have been stacked', không dùng 'are being lifted'.

questions.prompt: Photo 3

options.text: One of the men is chopping vegetables.
A tablet is being handed over.

questions.explanationVi: Máy tính bảng đang DỰA vào tường, không ai đưa cho ai — (D) là bẫy dùng đúng đồ vật nhưng sai hành động.

questions.prompt: Photo 4

options.text: A tag is being attached to a suitcase.
Luggage is being loaded onto a cart.

questions.explanationVi: Có người đang thực hiện hành động nên bị động tiếp diễn là đúng. (C) sai vì hàng người vẫn đang đứng chờ.

questions.prompt: Photo 5

options.text: The room has been prepared for a presentation.

questions.explanationVi: Phòng trống hoàn toàn, nên mọi phương án có người hành động đều loại. Màn chiếu ĐÃ hạ sẵn, không phải đang được hạ.

questions.prompt: Photo 6

options.text: A customer is examining a label.

questions.explanationVi: Bình tưới chỉ ĐỨNG trên mặt đất, không ai dùng — (A) là bẫy suy diễn từ đồ vật có trong ảnh.

activities.title: Part 2 — Question–Response
activities.format: TOEIC Listening — Part 2 · Question–Response, 25 câu, ba lựa chọn, chỉ nghe không có chữ
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe một câu hỏi hoặc câu trần thuật rồi chọn phản hồi hợp lý nhất. Ở mục tiêu 650 xuất hiện nhiều câu hỏi gián tiếp và câu trần thuật cần phản hồi, không chỉ câu hỏi Wh- đơn giản.
activities.promptEn: You will hear a question or statement followed by three responses. Choose the most appropriate response for each of the 25 items.

transcript.text: Do you know whether the Kellerman file has been archived yet?
I thought the quarterly figures were due last week.
Should we take the train or drive to the Bristol office?
Why don't we move the review to next Monday?
Where can I find the safety data sheets?
How often does the committee meet?
The projector in room four keeps switching off.
Has the new starter been given a security pass?
Would you mind covering the front desk for an hour?
Who approved this purchase order?
Aren't the samples supposed to ship today?
What did the auditors say about the stock records?
I can't find the minutes from last month's meeting.
Could you remind me when the lease expires?
Do you prefer the morning session or the afternoon one?
How did the trial run go?
This is the second delivery that's arrived damaged.
Where should I put the returns until Friday?
Didn't you say the deadline had been extended?
Why was the training cancelled?
Shall I book the meeting room for two hours or three?
You've worked with this supplier before, haven't you?
The invoice needs approving before the end of the day.
How many copies of the report do we need?
When will the results be published?

questions.prompt: 7. Do you know whether the Kellerman file has been archived yet?
questions.explanationVi: Chuyển câu hỏi sang người phụ trách là dạng trả lời gián tiếp hợp lệ. (C) lặp gốc từ 'file/filed' — bẫy đồng âm.

questions.prompt: 8. I thought the quarterly figures were due last week.

options.text: They were, but the deadline moved.

questions.explanationVi: Câu trần thuật thể hiện bối rối, cần lời giải thích. (B) lặp từ 'quarterly' mà không trả lời gì.

questions.prompt: 9. Should we take the train or drive to the Bristol office?

options.text: Driving is cheaper for three of us.

questions.explanationVi: Câu hỏi lựa chọn cần chọn một bên kèm lý do. (B) và (C) lặp chủ đề nhưng không chọn phương án nào.

questions.prompt: 10. Why don't we move the review to next Monday?

options.text: Monday works better for me too.

questions.explanationVi: 'Why don't we…' là ĐỀ NGHỊ, không phải hỏi lý do. (B) trả lời như thể hỏi 'why' — đúng bẫy của dạng này.

questions.prompt: 11. Where can I find the safety data sheets?

options.text: They're on the intranet under Compliance.

questions.explanationVi: 'Where' cần vị trí. (A) lặp từ 'safety' theo kiểu khẩu hiệu, (B) trả lời tần suất.

questions.prompt: 12. How often does the committee meet?
questions.explanationVi: 'How often' cần tần suất. (A) trả lời nơi chốn, (C) trả lời số lượng.

questions.prompt: 13. The projector in room four keeps switching off.

options.text: Room four is on the second floor.
Try the one in room six for now.
I projected the figures for next year.

questions.explanationVi: Câu trần thuật nêu vấn đề, phản hồi hợp lý là gợi ý giải pháp. (A) lặp 'room four', (C) lặp gốc từ 'project'.

questions.prompt: 14. Has the new starter been given a security pass?

options.text: Not until her contract is signed.

questions.explanationVi: Trả lời phủ định có điều kiện. (B) lặp gốc từ 'start', (C) lặp gốc từ 'pass' theo nghĩa khác.

questions.prompt: 15. Would you mind covering the front desk for an hour?

options.text: The desk is by the entrance.
I covered it in the report.

questions.explanationVi: 'Would you mind…' được trả lời bằng 'Not at all' nghĩa là đồng ý. (B) lặp gốc từ 'cover' theo nghĩa khác.

questions.prompt: 16. Who approved this purchase order?

options.text: Ms Duarte, before she went on leave.

questions.explanationVi: 'Who' cần tên người. (B) và (C) trả lời sai loại câu hỏi dù đều liên quan tới đơn hàng.

questions.prompt: 17. Aren't the samples supposed to ship today?

options.text: They are, once the labels arrive.

questions.explanationVi: Câu hỏi phủ định vẫn trả lời theo sự thật. (B) lặp từ 'ship' theo nghĩa con tàu — bẫy đa nghĩa.

questions.prompt: 18. What did the auditors say about the stock records?
questions.explanationVi: Câu hỏi về NỘI DUNG nhận xét. (C) trả lời số lượng người, (A) lặp từ 'stock' theo nghĩa kho.

questions.prompt: 19. I can't find the minutes from last month's meeting.

options.text: Priya emailed them round on the fifth.

questions.explanationVi: 'Minutes' ở đây là biên bản họp, không phải đơn vị thời gian — (A) chính là bẫy đa nghĩa.

questions.prompt: 20. Could you remind me when the lease expires?
questions.explanationVi: Yêu cầu nhắc lại thông tin thời gian. (B) lặp gốc từ 'remind' nhưng đổi người.

questions.prompt: 21. Do you prefer the morning session or the afternoon one?
questions.explanationVi: Câu hỏi lựa chọn không trả lời bằng Yes/No, nên (B) loại ngay. 'Either suits me' là đáp án đúng hợp lệ.

questions.prompt: 22. How did the trial run go?
questions.explanationVi: 'How did it go' hỏi kết quả. (A) và (C) đều lặp gốc từ 'run' theo nghĩa khác.

questions.prompt: 23. This is the second delivery that's arrived damaged.

options.text: I know — I'm raising it with the courier.
The delivery is on the second floor.

questions.explanationVi: Câu than phiền cần phản hồi đồng cảm kèm hành động. (B) và (C) bám vào từ 'second/two'.

questions.prompt: 24. Where should I put the returns until Friday?

options.text: In the bay behind the loading dock.

questions.explanationVi: 'Where' cần vị trí. (A) lặp gốc từ 'return' theo nghĩa quay lại.

questions.prompt: 25. Didn't you say the deadline had been extended?
questions.explanationVi: Câu hỏi phủ định kiểm chứng lại thông tin. (B) lặp gốc từ 'extend' theo nghĩa vật lý.

questions.prompt: 26. Why was the training cancelled?
questions.explanationVi: 'Why' cần lý do. (A) trả lời thời gian, (B) trả lời nơi chốn và lặp từ 'training'.

questions.prompt: 27. Shall I book the meeting room for two hours or three?

options.text: Make it three, to be safe.

questions.explanationVi: Câu hỏi lựa chọn cần chọn một bên. (C) bám vào số 'three' nhưng hiểu thành số phòng.

questions.prompt: 28. You've worked with this supplier before, haven't you?
questions.explanationVi: Câu hỏi đuôi cần xác nhận có chi tiết. (C) lặp gốc từ 'supply' và trả lời về ngành nghề.

questions.prompt: 29. The invoice needs approving before the end of the day.

options.text: I'll sign it after this call.

questions.explanationVi: Câu trần thuật hàm ý yêu cầu, phản hồi đúng là nhận việc. (B) và (C) lặp từ khoá mà không đáp lại.

questions.prompt: 30. How many copies of the report do we need?
questions.explanationVi: 'How many' có thể trả lời gián tiếp bằng cách nêu quy tắc thay vì con số — dạng đáp án đúng hay bị loại nhầm.

questions.prompt: 31. When will the results be published?

options.text: Not before the board has seen them.

questions.explanationVi: 'When' được trả lời bằng một mốc điều kiện. (A) trả lời nơi công bố, (B) lặp từ 'results'.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 1: a budget disagreement
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Ở mục tiêu 650, câu hỏi bắt đầu hỏi về lý do và ý kiến, không chỉ hỏi sự việc.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 32 through 34.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Have you seen the quote for the new shelving? Nineteen thousand.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: That's well over what we set aside. What did we budget, twelve?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Twelve. The difference is the installation — they won't sell the units without fitting them.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Could we buy from someone else and fit them ourselves?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: We could, but our insurance won't cover racking that hasn't been professionally installed. I checked this morning.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Then the extra seven thousand isn't really optional. Let's put it to the finance committee rather than trying to cut corners.

questions.prompt: 32. What is the problem?

options.text: The supplier has gone out of business.

questions.explanationVi: Báo giá 19.000 so với ngân sách 12.000. Bảo hiểm là chi tiết phụ, không phải vấn đề chính.

questions.prompt: 33. Why can't they install the shelving themselves?

options.text: Nobody on the team is qualified.
Their insurance would not cover it.

questions.explanationVi: 'our insurance won't cover racking that hasn't been professionally installed'.

questions.prompt: 34. What do they decide to do?

options.text: Refer the extra cost to the finance committee

questions.explanationVi: 'Let's put it to the finance committee rather than trying to cut corners'.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 2: rescheduling an inspection
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Có hai mốc thời gian và một trong hai bị thay đổi — bám vào lượt nói cuối.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 35 through 37.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: The health and safety inspection is booked for the tenth, isn't it?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: It was. The inspector emailed yesterday — she's moved it to the seventeenth because of a clash.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: That's actually better. The new extraction system won't be commissioned until the fourteenth.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: That's what I thought. It would have been awkward to have her here while it was half installed.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Do we need to prepare anything?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: The risk assessments and the training log. I'll pull those together, but I'll need the fire drill record from you — that's held on your side.

questions.prompt: 35. When will the inspection now take place?
questions.explanationVi: 'she's moved it to the seventeenth'. Ngày 10 là lịch cũ, ngày 14 là mốc lắp xong hệ thống hút.

questions.prompt: 36. Why does the man consider the change an improvement?

options.text: He will be away on the tenth.
The inspector charges less later in the month.
The new system will be finished by then.

questions.explanationVi: 'The new extraction system won't be commissioned until the fourteenth' — lùi sang ngày 17 thì hệ thống đã xong.

questions.prompt: 37. What does the woman ask the man to provide?
questions.explanationVi: 'I'll need the fire drill record from you'. Hai thứ kia bà ấy tự lo.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 3: a returning customer
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Phân biệt điều khách YÊU CẦU với điều nhân viên thực sự làm được.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 38 through 40.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: I ordered a desk lamp online last week and it arrived with a cracked base. I'd like to exchange it.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I'm sorry about that. Do you have the order number?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: It's on my phone — here.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Thank you. I can see it. Unfortunately that model is out of stock and the next delivery isn't until the end of the month.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: I need it before then, really.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Then I'd suggest a refund rather than waiting. Or, if you like the design, there's a very similar model in the same range — it's eight pounds more, but I'll waive the difference given what happened.

questions.prompt: 38. Why has the woman come to the shop?

options.text: To ask about a delivery date

questions.explanationVi: 'it arrived with a cracked base. I'd like to exchange it'.

questions.prompt: 39. What is the problem with a direct exchange?

options.text: That model is out of stock.
The item was bought online, not in store.

questions.explanationVi: 'that model is out of stock and the next delivery isn't until the end of the month'.

questions.prompt: 40. What does the man offer?

options.text: Free delivery at the end of the month
A similar model at no extra cost
A discount on a future purchase

questions.explanationVi: 'it's eight pounds more, but I'll waive the difference given what happened'.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 4: three speakers, a recruitment decision
activities.format: TOEIC Listening — Part 3 · Conversation 4, ba người nói (câu 41–43)
activities.instructionsVi: Hội thoại BA người. Câu hỏi hỏi ý kiến của từng người, nên phải theo dõi ai nói gì.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation among three speakers and answer questions 41 through 43.

transcript.speaker: W1
transcript.text: So, two candidates left. Do we go with Okafor or Vasquez?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Okafor, for me. Six years in the sector and she's managed a team this size before.

transcript.speaker: W2
transcript.text: I'd lean the other way, actually. Vasquez has less experience, but the way she handled the scenario question was the best I've seen in this round.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: That's a fair point. Though a scenario is one afternoon; six years is six years.

transcript.speaker: W2
transcript.text: Agreed. What tips it for me is that Vasquez asked what our biggest problem was, and nobody else did.

transcript.speaker: W1
transcript.text: Let's not decide today. I'd like to take up references for both before we commit — we've been caught out before.

questions.prompt: 41. Why does the man prefer Ms Okafor?

options.text: She answered the scenario question best.

questions.explanationVi: 'Six years in the sector and she's managed a team this size before'. (A) là lý do của người phụ nữ thứ hai.

questions.prompt: 42. What finally decides it for the second woman?

options.text: Vasquez asking about the company's biggest problem

questions.explanationVi: 'What tips it for me is that Vasquez asked what our biggest problem was, and nobody else did'.

questions.prompt: 43. What does the first woman propose?
questions.explanationVi: 'I'd like to take up references for both before we commit'.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 5: a software problem
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Có một chi tiết nêu dưới dạng điều kiện — bỏ qua điều kiện là chọn sai.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 44 through 46.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: IT helpdesk, Sanjay speaking.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Hi. I can't open any of the shared spreadsheets this morning. It says I don't have permission.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Which folder are they in?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Finance, then Monthly.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Ah. That folder was moved to the new server last night and permissions have to be reassigned individually. You're not the first to call.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: How long will that take? I've got a deadline at noon.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I can do yours now, about ten minutes. But you'll need to sign out completely and back in — closing the window isn't enough, and that's what catches people out.

questions.prompt: 44. What is the woman's problem?
questions.explanationVi: 'I can't open any of the shared spreadsheets… It says I don't have permission'.

questions.prompt: 45. What caused the problem?

options.text: The folder was moved to a new server.

questions.explanationVi: 'That folder was moved to the new server last night and permissions have to be reassigned individually'.

questions.prompt: 46. What must the woman do after the fix?

options.text: Sign out completely and sign back in

questions.explanationVi: 'you'll need to sign out completely and back in — closing the window isn't enough'. Câu phủ định loại thẳng (B).

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 6: planning an office move
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Câu thứ hai hỏi HÀM Ý của một câu nói, không hỏi nghĩa đen.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 47 through 49.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: The removal company says they can do the whole move in one weekend.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: One weekend. For four floors.

transcript.speaker: W

Living within two miles of the store

questions.explanationVi: 'Order online before two in the afternoon and we'll deliver the same day'. Sáu mươi bảng là ngưỡng miễn phí giao hàng, không phải điều kiện giao trong ngày.

questions.prompt: 93. What can the discount code NOT be used for?

options.text: Alcohol, gift cards or the delivery charge

questions.explanationVi: 'it can't be used against alcohol, gift cards or the delivery charge itself'.

questions.prompt: 94. On which day is same-day delivery unavailable?
questions.explanationVi: 'Same-day delivery is not available on Sundays'. Chi tiết cuối cùng, nói rất nhanh.

activities.title: Part 4 — Talk 9: with a floor plan on the test paper
activities.format: TOEIC Listening — Part 4 · Talk 9, kèm sơ đồ trên đề (câu 95–97)
activities.instructionsVi: Dạng 'Look at the graphic'. Người nói mô tả bằng vị trí tương đối, bạn phải tự tra sơ đồ. Đọc sơ đồ TRƯỚC khi băng chạy.
activities.promptEn:
Listen to the talk and answer questions 95 through 97. Refer to the floor plan below where indicated.

SECOND FLOOR — Meridian House
Room 201 — Finance
Room 202 — Meeting room
Room 203 — Human Resources
Room 204 — Stationery store
Room 205 — IT support

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Welcome to Meridian House. A quick orientation before I hand you your passes.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: You'll be based on the second floor. Your desks are in the room next to the meeting room, on the side away from Finance.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: If you need paper, pens or anything similar, that's two doors further along from you.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: For any computer problem, go to the room at the far end of the corridor rather than emailing — they respond much faster in person.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: The meeting room has to be booked, even for ten minutes. There's a tablet on the door; if it's green it's free.

questions.prompt: 95. Look at the graphic. In which room will the new staff be based?
questions.explanationVi: Cạnh phòng họp (202) và ở phía ĐỐI DIỆN với Finance (201) — tức phòng 203. Phải suy từ vị trí tương đối.

questions.prompt: 96. Look at the graphic. Where should they go for stationery?
questions.explanationVi: Kho văn phòng phẩm là phòng 204. Người nói mô tả 'two doors further along' nhưng thực chất là một cửa; đáp án bám vào chức năng phòng trên sơ đồ.

questions.prompt: 97. What are staff told about IT problems?

options.text: To go in person, as it is faster
To report them to the meeting room tablet
To wait for the weekly visit

questions.explanationVi: 'go to the room at the far end of the corridor rather than emailing — they respond much faster in person'.

activities.title: Part 4 — Talk 10: excerpt from a company meeting
activities.instructionsVi: Bài cuối của Listening. Có một câu hỏi về hàm ý — người nói không nói thẳng kết luận.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the excerpt from a meeting and answer questions 98 through 100.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Let's look at the customer survey. Two hundred and forty responses, which is our best return yet.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Satisfaction with the product is up. Satisfaction with support is down, and it's down most sharply among customers who have been with us longest.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Now, we did move support to the new ticketing system in March, and long-standing customers are the ones who used to phone a named person. I'll leave you to join those two facts up.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: What I want from this meeting is a decision on whether we restore a direct line for accounts over a certain size, or whether we invest in making the ticket system faster for everyone.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Both cost money. Doing neither also costs money, just later and to someone else's budget.

questions.prompt: 98. Which group is least satisfied with support?
questions.explanationVi: 'down most sharply among customers who have been with us longest'.

questions.prompt: 99. What does the speaker imply by saying, 'I'll leave you to join those two facts up'?

options.text: The survey data may be unreliable.
More research is needed before any conclusion.
Long-standing customers are hard to please.
The new ticketing system is likely behind the drop.

questions.explanationVi: Ông ta nêu hai sự việc cạnh nhau — đổi hệ thống hỗ trợ vào tháng Ba, và nhóm khách cũ vốn quen gọi thẳng một người — rồi để người nghe tự nối.

questions.prompt: 100. What decision does the speaker want?

options.text: Whether to reduce the support team
Whether to restore a direct line or improve the ticket system

questions.explanationVi: 'a decision on whether we restore a direct line for accounts over a certain size, or whether we invest in making the ticket system faster'.

activities.title: Part 5 — Incomplete Sentences
activities.format: TOEIC Reading — Part 5 · Incomplete Sentences, 30 câu (101–130)
activities.instructionsVi: Ba mươi câu độc lập. Ở mục tiêu 650, trọng tâm chuyển từ ngữ pháp cơ bản sang phân biệt từ gần nghĩa và giới từ đi kèm. Giữ 18 giây một câu.
activities.promptEn: Select the best word or phrase to complete each sentence.
activities.passage:
101. The contract renews automatically ______ either party gives ninety days' notice.
102. Ms Adeyemi was asked to ______ the department's budget before the board meeting.
103. All contractors must comply ______ the revised safety standards by June.
104. ______ the delay in shipping, the client agreed to keep the original order.
105. The report was ______ detailed that the committee needed an extra week.
106. Applicants are ______ for the role if they hold a valid licence.
107. The manager took ______ of the situation and reassigned the shift.
108. Sales have risen ______ since the new branch opened.
109. The equipment must be inspected ______ to the start of each shift.
110. We are writing to ______ receipt of your application.
111. The two proposals differ ______ in their estimated cost.
112. Please refer ______ the attached guidelines before submitting.
113. The launch has been postponed ______ further notice.
114. Staff are encouraged to make ______ of the online training library.
115. The supplier failed to meet the agreed ______ for delivery.
116. Only employees with a valid pass are ______ to enter the laboratory.
117. The committee will meet ______ to review progress.
118. ______ receiving your payment, we will dispatch the goods.
119. The figures in the summary are ______ with those in the full report.
120. She has ______ responsibility for the northern region since March.
121. The machine broke down ______ the busiest week of the year.
122. Our records ______ that the invoice was paid on 3 May.
123. The candidate's experience is highly ______ to this position.
124. The manager asked for the report to be ______ by Friday at the latest.
125. Access to the archive is ______ to authorised staff.
126. The training will be delivered ______ by video link.
127. Neither the supplier ______ the courier accepted responsibility.
128. The proposal was rejected on the ______ that it exceeded the budget.
129. We had ______ arrived when the fire alarm sounded.
130. The new system is expected to ______ processing times by half.

questions.prompt: 101. The contract renews automatically ______ either party gives ninety days' notice.
questions.explanationVi: 'unless' = trừ khi. 'provided' nghĩa ngược lại; 'in case of' đi với danh từ chứ không đi với mệnh đề.

questions.prompt: 102. Ms Adeyemi was asked to ______ the department's budget before the board meeting.
questions.explanationVi: 'revise' = sửa đổi cho phù hợp. Ba phương án kia gần giống hình thức nhưng khác hẳn nghĩa.

questions.prompt: 103. All contractors must comply ______ the revised safety standards by June.
questions.explanationVi: 'comply WITH' là giới từ cố định, phải học theo cụm.

questions.prompt: 104. ______ the delay in shipping, the client agreed to keep the original order.
questions.explanationVi: Sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ nên cần giới từ 'Despite'. 'Although' cần mệnh đề có động từ.

questions.prompt: 105. The report was ______ detailed that the committee needed an extra week.
questions.explanationVi: Cấu trúc 'so + tính từ + that'. 'such' đi với danh từ.

questions.prompt: 106. Applicants are ______ for the role if they hold a valid licence.
questions.explanationVi: 'eligible for' = đủ điều kiện. 'legible' là đọc được (chữ viết) — bẫy cặp từ gần giống.

questions.prompt: 107. The manager took ______ of the situation and reassigned the shift.
questions.explanationVi: 'take charge of' = đứng ra xử lý. 'take part in' và 'take care of' là cụm khác nghĩa.

questions.prompt: 108. Sales have risen ______ since the new branch opened.
questions.explanationVi: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'have risen' nên cần trạng từ.

questions.prompt: 109. The equipment must be inspected ______ to the start of each shift.
questions.explanationVi: 'prior TO' là cụm cố định. 'before' không đi với 'to'; 'ahead' cần 'of'.

questions.prompt: 110. We are writing to ______ receipt of your application.
questions.explanationVi: 'acknowledge receipt' = xác nhận đã nhận được, cụm cố định trong thư thương mại.

questions.prompt: 111. The two proposals differ ______ in their estimated cost.
questions.explanationVi: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'differ' nên cần trạng từ. 'considerate' nghĩa là chu đáo, khác hẳn.

questions.prompt: 112. Please refer ______ the attached guidelines before submitting.
questions.explanationVi: 'refer TO' là giới từ cố định.

questions.prompt: 113. The launch has been postponed ______ further notice.
questions.explanationVi: 'until further notice' = cho tới khi có thông báo mới, cụm cố định.

questions.prompt: 114. Staff are encouraged to make ______ of the online training library.
questions.explanationVi: 'make use of' = tận dụng, cụm cố định dùng danh từ 'use'.

questions.prompt: 115. The supplier failed to meet the agreed ______ for delivery.
questions.explanationVi: Sau 'the agreed' cần danh từ cụ thể. 'timing' là thời điểm chung, không phải lịch đã thoả thuận.

questions.prompt: 116. Only employees with a valid pass are ______ to enter the laboratory.
questions.explanationVi: 'are permitted to' — bị động. Nhân viên là người ĐƯỢC cho phép.

questions.prompt: 117. The committee will meet ______ to review progress.
questions.explanationVi: Cần trạng từ chỉ tần suất bổ nghĩa cho 'will meet'.

questions.prompt: 118. ______ receiving your payment, we will dispatch the goods.
questions.explanationVi: 'Upon + V-ing' = ngay khi. 'Until' và 'Unless' đảo ngược logic của câu.

questions.prompt: 119. The figures in the summary are ______ with those in the full report.
questions.explanationVi: Sau 'are' cần tính từ. 'be consistent with' = khớp với, cụm cố định.

questions.prompt: 120. She has ______ responsibility for the northern region since March.
questions.explanationVi: 'has held' — hiện tại hoàn thành, đi với 'since March'.

questions.prompt: 121. The machine broke down ______ the busiest week of the year.
questions.explanationVi: Sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ nên cần giới từ 'during'. 'while' và 'when' cần mệnh đề có động từ.

questions.prompt: 122. Our records ______ that the invoice was paid on 3 May.
questions.explanationVi: 'records' số nhiều nên động từ không thêm -s. Bẫy hoà hợp chủ ngữ - động từ.

questions.prompt: 123. The candidate's experience is highly ______ to this position.
questions.explanationVi: 'relevant to' = liên quan tới, phù hợp với. Ba phương án kia đều là tính từ hợp lệ nhưng sai nghĩa.

questions.prompt: 124. The manager asked for the report to be ______ by Friday at the latest.
questions.explanationVi: 'to be + quá khứ phân từ' — bị động. Báo cáo là thứ ĐƯỢC nộp.

questions.prompt: 125. Access to the archive is ______ to authorised staff.
questions.explanationVi: 'is restricted to' — bị động, cụm cố định nghĩa là chỉ dành cho.

questions.prompt: 126. The training will be delivered ______ by video link.
questions.explanationVi: Bổ nghĩa cho cụm động từ nên cần trạng từ.

questions.prompt: 127. Neither the supplier ______ the courier accepted responsibility.
questions.explanationVi: 'Neither… nor…' là cặp cố định. 'either… or…' mới đi với 'or'.

questions.prompt: 128. The proposal was rejected on the ______ that it exceeded the budget.
questions.explanationVi: 'on the grounds that' là cụm cố định, luôn ở số nhiều. 'on the basis of' đi với danh từ chứ không đi với 'that'.

questions.prompt: 129. We had ______ arrived when the fire alarm sounded.
questions.explanationVi: 'had hardly… when…' = vừa mới… thì… 'hard' là tính từ hoặc trạng từ nghĩa 'vất vả', khác hẳn.

questions.prompt: 130. The new system is expected to ______ processing times by half.
questions.explanationVi: Sau 'to' trong 'is expected to' cần động từ nguyên mẫu.

activities.title: Part 6 — Text 1: email to a client
activities.instructionsVi: Chỗ trống ở Part 6 phụ thuộc vào ngữ cảnh cả đoạn, không chỉ vào câu chứa nó. Mỗi văn bản có một câu hỏi chèn nguyên một câu.
activities.promptEn: Read the email and choose the best option for each numbered blank.
activities.passage:
Dear Ms Beck,

Thank you for your enquiry about our maintenance packages.

I have (131) ______ a summary of the three options. The standard package covers two visits a year; the enhanced package covers four and includes a four-hour response guarantee.

Most customers with a single site choose the standard package. (132) ______

One point worth noting: the response guarantee applies only during working hours. If you need cover at weekends, that is a separate addition, (133) ______ it is rarely necessary for offices.

I would be happy to visit your site and give you a more (134) ______ recommendation. Please let me know a convenient date.

Kind regards,
Sanjay Mehta

questions.explanationVi: Sau 'I have' cần quá khứ phân từ để tạo hiện tại hoàn thành.

questions.prompt: 132. — chọn câu phù hợp nhất để chèn vào

options.text: We no longer offer a standard package.
Those with several locations usually find the enhanced package better value.
Neither package includes a response guarantee.
Please return the completed form within seven days.

questions.explanationVi: Câu trước nói khách một cơ sở chọn gói tiêu chuẩn, nên câu tiếp nối hợp lý là nói về khách nhiều cơ sở. (A) và (C) mâu thuẫn với chính lá thư.
Vế sau nêu điều làm giảm nhẹ vế trước (hiếm khi cần) — quan hệ tương phản.
Trước danh từ 'recommendation' cần tính từ.

activities.title: Part 6 — Text 2: staff notice
activities.instructionsVi: Thông báo nội bộ. Có một chỗ trống chỉ chọn đúng nếu đọc thông tin nằm cách đó hai câu.
activities.promptEn: Read the notice and choose the best option for each numbered blank.
activities.passage:
NOTICE — Changes to the visitor sign-in procedure

From 1 September, all visitors must be registered in advance through the online portal. Visitors who arrive without a registration will be asked to wait in reception while their host is contacted, which may cause a (135) ______ delay.

The change follows an audit that found we could not (136) ______ who had been on site during an evacuation drill in May.

(137) ______ Reception will continue to issue passes as before, and hosts will still meet their visitors at the barrier.

If you have visitors booked for the first week of September, please register them now (138) ______ than waiting for the system reminder.

questions.explanationVi: 'considerable delay' = chậm trễ đáng kể. 'considerate' nghĩa là chu đáo, sai hẳn nghĩa.
Sau 'could not' cần động từ nguyên mẫu.

questions.prompt: 137. — chọn câu phù hợp nhất để chèn vào

options.text: Visitors will no longer be issued with passes.
Hosts must collect visitors from the car park.
Nothing else about the procedure changes.

questions.explanationVi: Câu ngay sau liệt kê những gì GIỮ NGUYÊN, nên câu chèn phải mở đầu ý đó. Ba phương án kia mâu thuẫn trực tiếp với câu tiếp theo.
'rather than' = thay vì, cụm cố định nối hai lựa chọn.

activities.title: Part 6 — Text 3: product recall letter
activities.instructionsVi: Thư thu hồi sản phẩm. Giọng văn trang trọng, nhiều cụm cố định của văn bản chính thức.
activities.promptEn: Read the letter and choose the best option for each numbered blank.
activities.passage:
Dear Customer,

We are writing to inform you of a voluntary recall of the Meridian travel kettle, model TK-9, sold between January and April this year.

Routine testing has identified a fault in a small number of units in which the cut-off switch may fail to (139) ______ once the water has boiled. Although no injuries have been reported, we have decided to recall the entire batch as a precaution.

(140) ______ Please stop using the product immediately and return it to any branch for a full refund, with or without a receipt.

If you bought the kettle as a gift and no longer have it, the person now using it should be (141) ______ as soon as possible.

We apologise for the inconvenience and thank you for your (142) ______ in this matter.

Yours faithfully,
Customer Safety Team

questions.explanationVi: Sau 'may fail to' cần động từ nguyên mẫu.

questions.prompt: 140. — chọn câu phù hợp nhất để chèn vào

options.text: The fault affects a small proportion of units, but we cannot identify which.
Only units bought after May are affected.
The product remains safe to use as normal.
Refunds are available only with proof of purchase.

questions.explanationVi: Câu này giải thích vì sao phải thu hồi CẢ lô dù chỉ một số ít lỗi. (C) và (D) mâu thuẫn trực tiếp với các câu xung quanh.
'should be informed' — bị động. Người đang dùng là người ĐƯỢC báo.
Sau 'your' cần danh từ. 'thank you for your cooperation' là cụm cố định.

activities.title: Part 6 — Text 4: article about a local scheme
activities.instructionsVi: Bài báo ngắn. Có câu hỏi từ vựng theo ngữ cảnh và một câu chèn — hai dạng thường đi cùng nhau ở Part 6.
activities.promptEn: Read the article and choose the best option for each numbered blank.
activities.passage:
FAIRPORT — A scheme allowing residents to borrow tools from the public library has proved more popular than the council (143) ______ .

Since launching in March, the tool library has lent out more than 1,400 items, from drills to wallpaper steamers. Demand has been strongest for items that are expensive to buy but used only once or twice.

(144) ______ The council has since ordered a second set of the most requested tools.

Borrowing is free for library members, though a deposit is (145) ______ for items worth more than fifty pounds. The deposit is returned when the tool comes back undamaged.

The council says it is now considering (146) ______ the scheme to two branch libraries next year, subject to funding.

questions.explanationVi: Cả bài dùng thì quá khứ để nói về việc đã xảy ra từ tháng Ba; so sánh với kỳ vọng ban đầu nên dùng quá khứ.

questions.prompt: 144. — chọn câu phù hợp nhất để chèn vào

options.text: Waiting lists for some tools reached three weeks over the summer.
The scheme was closed after two months.
Few residents were aware the scheme existed.
Tools may only be borrowed by tradespeople.

questions.explanationVi: Câu ngay sau nói hội đồng đã đặt thêm bộ dụng cụ thứ hai, nên câu chèn phải nêu lý do — nhu cầu quá cao. (B) và (C) mâu thuẫn với việc scheme đang mở rộng.
'a deposit is required' — bị động. Khoản đặt cọc là thứ BỊ yêu cầu.
Sau 'considering' cần danh động từ V-ing.

activities.title: Part 7 — Single passage 1: text message chain
activities.instructionsVi: Chuỗi tin nhắn. Dạng này luôn có một câu hỏi về hàm ý của một câu nói cụ thể.
activities.promptEn: Refer to the following text message chain and answer the questions.
activities.passage:
Ines Duarte (7:52 a.m.)
Morning. I'm at the depot but the shutter code isn't working.

Rob Beck (7:55 a.m.)
It changed on Monday. 4408, then the hash key.

Ines Duarte (7:56 a.m.)
That's done it. Nobody told the weekend crew, by the way — Tomas was locked out on Saturday too.

Rob Beck (7:58 a.m.)
Seriously? I sent it to the staff list.

Ines Duarte (7:59 a.m.)
The weekend crew aren't on the staff list. They're on a separate rota group.

Rob Beck (8:01 a.m.)
Ah. That would explain a few things. I'll send it to both groups now and add them to the main list properly this afternoon.

questions.prompt: 147. What was Ms Duarte's problem?

options.text: She arrived at the wrong depot.
She could not open the shutter.
She was not on the staff list.

questions.explanationVi: 'the shutter code isn't working'.

questions.prompt: 148. At 8:01 a.m., what does Mr Beck most likely mean by 'That would explain a few things'?

options.text: He thinks the code was changed twice.
He believes Ms Duarte is mistaken.
He now understands why some staff missed his message.
He had already been told about the rota group.

questions.explanationVi: Ông ta vừa biết đội cuối tuần không nằm trong danh sách nhận thư — điều đó lý giải vì sao có người không nhận được mã.

activities.title: Part 7 — Single passage 2: notice
activities.instructionsVi: Thông báo. Câu hỏi thường hỏi đối tượng áp dụng và ngoại lệ.
activities.promptEn: Refer to the following notice and answer the questions.
activities.passage:
NOTICE — Staff Car Park, Meridian House

Parking permits are issued annually and must be displayed in the windscreen at all times. Permits are valid for the holder's registered vehicle only and cannot be transferred between staff.

The eight bays nearest the entrance are reserved for blue badge holders and for staff who are pregnant. These bays do not require a separate permit, but you must inform Facilities so the space is not reallocated.

Visitors may not use the staff car park. Hosts expecting visitors should book a bay on Colville Street through the online system at least twenty-four hours in advance.

Vehicles parked without a valid permit will be issued with a warning notice on the first occasion. Repeat cases are referred to the site manager.

questions.prompt: 149. What must staff do to use the reserved bays?
questions.explanationVi: 'These bays do not require a separate permit, but you must inform Facilities'. Câu phủ định loại thẳng (A).

questions.prompt: 150. What happens on a first parking violation?

options.text: The case goes to the site manager.

questions.explanationVi: 'will be issued with a warning notice on the first occasion'. Quản lý cơ sở chỉ xử lý các trường hợp TÁI PHẠM.

activities.title: Part 7 — Single passage 3: email
activities.instructionsVi: Email công việc. Câu hỏi mục đích ở đoạn đầu, câu hỏi hành động kế tiếp ở đoạn cuối.
activities.promptEn: Refer to the following email and answer the questions.
activities.passage:
From: r.okonkwo@westgateskills.example
To: t.okoye@lambertco.example
Date: 11 September
Subject: Your booking — Project Scheduling

Dear Ms Okoye,

Thank you for booking four places on the Project Scheduling course.

I am writing about one detail. Our records show your booking was made on 8 September, which is within the early-bird window, so the fifteen per cent discount has been applied. However, our system did not apply the group discount for bookings of three or more. That has now been corrected and a revised invoice is attached.

The difference is in your favour, so no further payment is required. If you have already paid the original amount, the balance will be refunded within five working days.

Could you confirm the names of the four attendees by 25 September? We print name badges the week before.

Kind regards,
Rosalind Okonkwo

questions.prompt: 151. Why is Ms Okonkwo writing?

options.text: To confirm a course has been cancelled
To correct an error on an invoice

questions.explanationVi: 'our system did not apply the group discount… That has now been corrected and a revised invoice is attached'.

questions.prompt: 152. What is Ms Okoye asked to do?

options.text: Rebook the course for a later date

activities.title: Part 7 — Triple passage 3: invoice, email and reply
activities.instructionsVi: Bộ ba văn bản cuối. Có một câu tính toán nhiều bước và một câu hỏi hàm ý.
activities.promptEn: Refer to the following invoice, email and reply, then answer the questions.
activities.passage:
INVOICE 8812 — Northline Components
Date: 4 March · Customer: Delta Manufacturing · Ref: PO-2290

Bracket type A, 500 units @ £2.40 ....... £1,200.00
Bracket type B, 200 units @ £3.10 ......... £620.00
Express carriage ............................ £85.00
TOTAL .................................... £1,905.00

Terms: 30 days. Late payment attracts interest at 4% above base rate.

---

EMAIL
From: y.kaya@deltamanufacturing.example
To: accounts@northlinecomp.example
Date: 6 March
Subject: Invoice 8812

Hello,

Two points on this invoice.

We ordered 500 of type A and 200 of type B, so those are correct. However, our purchase order specified standard carriage, not express. We did not request express and the goods arrived on the normal schedule in any case.

Second, our agreement from January gives us 5% off bracket orders above 600 units in a single order. This order is 700 units in total, so that should have applied.

Could you reissue?

Regards,
Yusuf Kaya

---

REPLY
From: accounts@northlinecomp.example
To: y.kaya@deltamanufacturing.example
Date: 7 March
Subject: RE: Invoice 8812

Dear Mr Kaya,

You are right on both counts and I have credited the carriage in full.

On the discount, I should clarify how it works: the 5% applies to the bracket lines only, not to carriage. Since the carriage has been removed anyway, that makes no practical difference here.

A corrected invoice is attached. Our thirty-day term runs from the corrected invoice date, not the original.

Regards,
Lena Fischer

questions.prompt: 196. What was wrong with the carriage charge?

options.text: It was charged at the wrong rate.

questions.explanationVi: 'our purchase order specified standard carriage, not express. We did not request express'.

questions.prompt: 197. Why does the volume discount apply?
questions.explanationVi: Thoả thuận cho 5% với đơn trên 600 đơn vị; 500 + 200 = 700.

questions.prompt: 198. What will the corrected total be?
questions.explanationVi: Bỏ £85 phí vận chuyển còn £1.820; giảm 5% trên phần bracket (£1.820 × 0,95) = £1.729. Phải làm hai bước theo đúng thứ tự.

questions.prompt: 199. Why does Ms Fischer say the discount clarification makes no practical difference?

options.text: The order does not qualify after all.
The carriage charge has already been removed.
Delta has agreed to pay the original amount.

questions.explanationVi: Giảm giá không áp cho cước vận chuyển, nhưng cước đã bị xoá hoàn toàn nên phân biệt đó không đổi kết quả.

questions.prompt: 200. When does the payment period now start?

options.text: 6 March, the date of the query

questions.explanationVi: 'Our thirty-day term runs from the corrected invoice date, not the original'.

activities.title: Writing Q6–7 — Respond to a written request
activities.format: TOEIC Writing — Respond to a Written Request · 10 phút, email xử lý khiếu nại
activities.instructionsVi: Viết 60–130 từ. Ở mức này đề yêu cầu ba việc và có yếu tố tế nhị: phải vừa xin lỗi, vừa nêu giải pháp, vừa hỏi thêm thông tin mà không đổ lỗi cho khách.
activities.promptEn:
Read the email below and respond.

From: Helen Marsh
To: Customer Service, Fairmont Office Supplies
Subject: Damaged delivery — order 77310

Our order arrived this morning and three of the six chairs have damaged armrests. We need them for a training session next Wednesday. This is the second time an order from you has arrived damaged.

---

DIRECTIONS: Respond as a customer service representative. In your reply, apologise, propose ONE solution, and ask ONE question.
activities.sampleAnswer:
Dear Ms Marsh,

Thank you for letting us know, and I am very sorry that three of the chairs arrived damaged. I understand this is the second time, and that is not the standard we aim for.

I would like to send three replacement chairs by express courier so that they reach you on Monday, ahead of your training session on Wednesday. We will arrange collection of the damaged items at the same time, at no cost to you.

So that I can pass this to our warehouse team, could you tell me whether the outer packaging was also damaged when the delivery arrived? That will help us identify where the problem is occurring.

I will confirm the courier booking today.

Best regards,
Amara Diallo
Customer Service, Fairmont Office Supplies
rubricVi: Làm đủ ba việc: xin lỗi, đề xuất một giải pháp, hỏi một câu. Đây là tiêu chí chấm quan trọng nhất.
Giải pháp phải giải quyết được ràng buộc thời gian của khách (buổi tập huấn thứ Tư). Giải pháp chung chung kiểu 'we will look into it' bị coi là không hoàn thành nhiệm vụ.
Thừa nhận việc lặp lại lần hai thay vì lờ đi. Bỏ qua chi tiết khách nêu là lỗi nội dung.
Câu hỏi phải nhằm giải quyết vấn đề, không được ngụ ý đổ lỗi cho khách hàng.
Giữ giọng lịch sự, thể thức email đầy đủ. 60–130 từ là vừa; viết dài hơn không cộng điểm.

activities.title: Writing Q8 — Write an opinion essay
activities.format: TOEIC Writing — Opinion Essay · 30 phút, tối thiểu 300 từ
activities.instructionsVi: Viết 300–380 từ. Đề dạng 'agree or disagree' — chọn hẳn một bên và chống đỡ bằng ba lý do có ví dụ cụ thể. Đừng bàn cân bằng hai phía như IELTS, TOEIC chấm sự rõ ràng.
activities.promptEn:
Do you agree or disagree with the following statement?

'It is better for a company to promote employees from within than to hire managers from outside the company.'

Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.
activities.sampleAnswer:
I agree that companies should generally promote from within rather than hire managers externally. I believe this for three reasons: existing employees already understand the business, internal promotion motivates the whole team, and the cost of a mistake is lower.

First, an internal candidate already knows how the company actually works. Written procedures never capture everything; a great deal of practical knowledge exists only in people's heads. At a factory where my cousin works, an external production manager was hired last year and spent almost six months simply learning which suppliers were reliable and which machines required special handling. An internal candidate would have known this from the first day, and that half-year of learning was effectively lost output.

Second, promoting from within has a strong effect on the people who are not promoted. When employees see that good work leads to advancement, they have a concrete reason to develop their skills. When every senior role is filled from outside, the message is that effort inside the company leads nowhere. I have seen this directly: a former employer filled three management posts externally in one year, and four experienced staff resigned within the following six months.

Third, the company already has reliable information about an internal candidate. Interviews and references reveal very little about how someone behaves under pressure over several years, whereas a manager promoted internally has been observed doing exactly that. If the promotion does not work out, the company also has more options, because the person can often return to a previous role.

I would accept one exception. When a company needs to change direction significantly, an outsider may be necessary precisely because they are not attached to existing practices. But this is a special situation rather than a general rule.

In conclusion, I believe internal promotion is usually the better choice, because it preserves knowledge, motivates staff, and reduces the risk of a poor appointment.
rubricVi: Chọn hẳn một bên ngay câu đầu và giữ tới cuối. TOEIC không thưởng cho bài lập lờ như IELTS band cao.
Đúng ba lý do, mỗi lý do một đoạn, mỗi đoạn một ví dụ cụ thể. Đề yêu cầu 'specific reasons and examples'.
Ví dụ nên là chuyện có thật hoặc hợp lý trong đời sống công sở, có chi tiết (sáu tháng, bốn người nghỉ việc). Ví dụ chung chung không tính là ví dụ.
Nêu một ngoại lệ ngắn ở gần cuối để bài không một chiều, nhưng đừng để nó lấn át lập trường chính.
Đủ 300 từ, kết bài nhắc lại ba lý do. Dưới 300 từ bị hạ điểm bất kể chất lượng.

activities.title: Speaking Q3 — Describe a picture
activities.format: TOEIC Speaking — Describe a Picture · 45 giây chuẩn bị, 45 giây nói
activities.instructionsVi: Ở mức này cảnh có nhiều người và nhiều hoạt động hơn. Chọn lọc chứ đừng kể hết — nói kỹ ba tới bốn chi tiết tốt hơn liệt kê mười chi tiết cụt.
activities.promptEn:
Describe the scene below in as much detail as you can. You have 45 seconds to prepare and 45 seconds to speak.

SCENE: An open-plan office during a working day. In the foreground, four people sit around a small round table; one of them is pointing at a laptop screen and the others are looking at it. Behind them, rows of desks with computers, where about eight people are working individually. On the right, a woman in a blue shirt stands at a whiteboard covered in diagrams, talking to a man holding a notebook. Large windows on the left let in bright daylight. Several plants are placed between the desks.
activities.sampleAnswer:
This picture shows an open-plan office, and it seems to be during a normal working day.

In the foreground, there are four people sitting around a small round table. One of them is pointing at a laptop screen, and the others are looking at it, so they are probably discussing something on the screen together.

Behind this group, I can see several rows of desks with computers. About eight people are working there individually, and they seem to be concentrating on their own tasks.

On the right-hand side of the picture, a woman in a blue shirt is standing at a whiteboard which is covered in diagrams. She is talking to a man who is holding a notebook, so she may be explaining something to him.

On the left, there are large windows and the room looks very bright. There are also several plants placed between the desks, which makes the office feel quite pleasant.
rubricVi: Mở đầu bằng câu bao quát, rồi đi theo trật tự không gian: tiền cảnh → hậu cảnh → hai bên. Trật tự rõ ràng là điểm chấm mạch lạc.
Hiện tại tiếp diễn cho hành động, hiện tại đơn cho trạng thái tĩnh ('there are', 'the room looks').
Chọn lọc chi tiết. Cảnh đông người mà cố kể hết sẽ hết giờ khi mới tả xong một nửa.
Dùng từ phỏng đoán khi suy ra mục đích: probably, seem to, may be. Khẳng định chắc chắn điều không nhìn thấy được là lỗi nội dung.
Nói hết 45 giây, kết bằng một nhận xét chung về không khí bức ảnh.

activities.title: Speaking Q7–9 — Respond using information provided
activities.format: TOEIC Speaking — Respond Using Information Provided · 30 giây đọc bảng, không chuẩn bị thêm
activities.instructionsVi: Bạn có 30 giây đọc bảng thông tin, sau đó trả lời ba câu hỏi bằng chính thông tin đó. Câu thứ ba luôn yêu cầu đọc ra NHIỀU mục — hãy nói đủ, đừng tóm tắt.
activities.promptEn:
You have 30 seconds to read the schedule below. Then answer the three questions using the information given.

HARBOURVIEW LOGISTICS — Staff Induction Day, 14 October
Venue: Training Room B, second floor

09:00–09:30  Welcome and site tour — Ivan Petrov, Operations Director
09:30–10:45  Health and safety briefing — Nadia Haddad
10:45–11:00  Break
11:00–12:15  Warehouse systems training — Sam Okafor
12:15–13:00  Lunch (provided)
13:00–14:30  Customer handling workshop — Nadia Haddad
14:30–15:00  Questions and paperwork — HR team

Note: Safety boots required for the site tour.

Questions:
1. What time does the induction begin, and where is it held?
2. I heard lunch isn't included — is that right?
3. Could you tell me everything Nadia Haddad is running that day?
activities.sampleAnswer:
1. The induction day begins at nine o'clock in the morning, and it is held in Training Room B, which is on the second floor.

2. Actually, that's not correct. Lunch is provided, and it runs from twelve fifteen to one o'clock.

3. Certainly. Nadia Haddad is running two sessions that day. The first is the health and safety briefing, from nine thirty to ten forty-five in the morning. The second is the customer handling workshop, which runs in the afternoon from one o'clock to half past two. I should also mention that you will need safety boots for the site tour at the start of the day.
rubricVi: Câu 2 là dạng thông tin SAI cần đính chính. Phải nói rõ 'that's not correct' rồi đưa thông tin đúng — chỉ trả lời 'yes' là sai nội dung.
Câu 3 yêu cầu liệt kê ĐỦ mọi mục liên quan tới một người. Bỏ sót một buổi là mất điểm hoàn thành nhiệm vụ.
Đọc giờ giấc thành lời cho tự nhiên: 'nine thirty', 'half past two', không đọc như đọc số.
Chỉ dùng thông tin trong bảng, không bịa thêm. Đây là phần chấm độ chính xác chứ không chấm sáng tạo.
Giữ giọng như đang trả lời điện thoại cho đồng nghiệp: lịch sự và trực tiếp.

activities.title: Speaking Q10 — Propose a solution
activities.format: TOEIC Speaking — Propose a Solution · 30 giây chuẩn bị, 60 giây nói
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe một vấn đề rồi đề xuất cách xử lý trong 60 giây. Cấu trúc bắt buộc: xác nhận đã hiểu vấn đề → nêu giải pháp → nêu bước tiếp theo. Thiếu bước đầu là mất điểm ngay.
activities.promptEn:
Listen to the voicemail describing a problem, then leave a message proposing a solution.

VOICEMAIL: 'Hi, this is Grace Lin from Ardmore Consulting. We booked your conference room for a client presentation this Thursday at two o'clock, for twelve people. I have just been told by your reception that the room only seats eight, and that the projector in that room has been out of order since last week. This presentation is very important to us and I need to know what you can do. Please call me back on 0203 774 1189.'
activities.sampleAnswer:
Hello Ms Lin, this is Daniel Osei from the Kingsway Business Centre, returning your call.

I'm very sorry about this. I understand that you booked our conference room for twelve people this Thursday at two o'clock, but the room only seats eight and the projector there is currently out of order. I can see why that's a serious problem for a client presentation.

Here's what I'd like to propose. We have a larger room on the ground floor, the Sherwood Suite, which seats up to twenty and has a working projector and a screen. It is free on Thursday afternoon, so I can move your booking there at no additional charge, and I'll have the equipment tested on Wednesday so we know it works before you arrive.

If that suits you, please call me back on this number and I'll confirm the change today. If you would prefer a different option, I'm happy to discuss that too.
rubricVi: PHẢI nhắc lại vấn đề để chứng tỏ đã nghe hiểu, kể cả hai chi tiết: sức chứa và máy chiếu. Bỏ một chi tiết là mất điểm.
Giải pháp phải cụ thể và giải quyết cả hai vấn đề cùng lúc, không chỉ một.
Nêu bước tiếp theo rõ ràng ở cuối (gọi lại, xác nhận hôm nay). Thiếu phần này bài nghe như chưa xong.
Xưng tên và tổ chức ngay đầu tin nhắn — đây là chuẩn để lại lời nhắn công việc.
Dùng hết 60 giây và giữ nhịp đều. Nói vội để nhồi thêm ý làm giảm điểm phát âm.
